summary: Farmmi, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to offer Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), with no special-situation catalyst such as acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The offering is a routine capital raise, with no forced management change or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer. As a non-special situation current report, it does not qualify for a special-situations category.
